modification_description: The deferred or cost-adjusted vacation must be made specific and time-bounded, not vague. Sarah must commit to: (1) a clearly defined revised reward specifying exactly what the team receives, (2) a concrete date or measurable trigger for when the vacation or its equivalent will be delivered, and (3) explicit assurances that honoring this promise will not result in layoffs, pay cuts, or reduced hours tied to this decision.
